info.title: Tapis Globus Proxy API
info.description: The Tapis Globus Proxy API proxies calls to Globus coming from a Tapis service.

tags.name: File Operations
tags.description: Manage file resources. Operations are list, mkdir, rename and delete

tags.name: Transfers
tags.description: Manage file transfers. Initiate, cancel and retrieve status.

get.summary: Return authorization URL given client Id
get.description:
Given a Globus Client Id return the authorization URL that can be used by an end-user to
authenticate and obtain a *Native App Authorization Code*.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Globus client associated with the request.

parameters.name: endpoint_id
parameters.description: Globus endpoint associated with the request.

get.summary: Exchange authorization code for access and refresh tokens
get.description: Exchange a Globus *Native App Authorization Code* for a pair of access and refresh tokens.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Tapis session Id tracking the OAuth2 flow.

get.summary: Check token pair and refresh as needed
get.description:
Given an endpoint and a pair of tokens refresh the pair as needed. Return the refreshed token pair
which may be the same as the provided pair.
Access and refresh tokens must be provided as query parameters.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Globus client associated with the request.

get.description:
List files for an endpoint at given path relative to the default directory of the endpoint.
Access token and refresh token must be provided as a query parameters.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Globus client associated with the request.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path relative to default directory of the endpoint

401.description: Access token invalid. Please provide valid token.

407.description: Unable to activate one or more endpoints.

delete.description:
Delete a file or directory on an endpoint at path {path} relative to the default directory.
Access token and refresh token must be provided as a query parameters.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Globus client associated with the request.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path relative to default directory of the endpoint

parameters.name: recurse
parameters.description: remove the directory and all subdirectories

401.description: Access token invalid. Please provide valid token.

407.description: Unable to activate one or more endpoints.

put.description:
Rename a file or directory on the endpoint. Paths are relative to the endpoint default directory.
Source and destination paths must be specified in the request body.
When renaming to a different parent directory, the parent directory of the new path must already exist.
Access token and refresh token must be provided as a query parameters.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Globus client associated with the request.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Source path relative to default directory of the endpoint

401.description: Access token invalid. Please provide valid token.

407.description: Unable to activate one or more endpoints.

post.description:
Create a directory on the endpoint. Path is relative to the endpoint default directory.
Access token and refresh token must be provided as a query parameters.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Globus client associated with the request.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path relative to default directory of the endpoint

not_used.description: Not used but some request body is required

401.description: Access token invalid. Please provide valid token.

407.description: Unable to activate one or more endpoints.

post.summary: Create task to transfer paths from one endpoint to another
post.description:
Create a task to transfer files from a source endpoint to a destination endpoint.
File paths are relative to the endpoint default directories.
Endpoints are activated as needed.
Access token and refresh token must be provided as a query parameters.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Globus client associated with the request.

recursive.description: Must be true for a directory path and false for a file.

401.description: Access token invalid. Please provide valid token.

407.description: Unable to activate one or more endpoints.

get.description:
Retrieve a transfer task given the task Id.
Access token and refresh token must be provided as a query parameters.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Globus client associated with the request.

401.description: Access token invalid. Please provide valid token.

407.description: Unable to activate one or more endpoints.

delete.description:
Request that a transfer task be cancelled. Note that even if the response indicates that the task has been
cancelled the task still may have succeeded. Task status must be checked. See Globus documentation.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: Globus client associated with the request.

407.description: Unable to activate one or more endpoints.
